messages:
erin: FYI — noticed ~6 staging private-controlplane pods failing to start after the RBAC refactor deployed at 03:10 UTC. Control-plane logs show KMS decrypt errors: "access denied for kms:Decrypt". Rolling back v2 role-mapping now.

samir: observed same. Looks like the onprem-admin role lost 'kms:decrypt' during the role-prune. I can reproduce with a service account impersonation test.

jordan: which PR? link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1423 ?

samir: yup that's the one. Policy module removed a broad legacy binding; intended, but mapping code didn't copy kms-perms to the new role binding. working on patch.

kms-bot: ALERT: 6 incidents detected — kms:Decrypt failures — staging/private-controlplane — incident id kc-20260318-07

qa: impact for customers? Any Dedicated clusters affected in prod?

erin: prod unaffected so far; only staging and a single dedicated-dev private env. No customer data exposed. Access denied prevents key unwrapping during bootstrap, so pods crash-loop.

jordan: quick mitigation: re-add a scoped binding for serviceaccounts in private-controlplane namespace to allow kms:Decrypt for now. Samir can you push?

samir: applying hotfix now:

```bash
gcloud iam policies set-iam-policy projects/redwood-platform \  --member="serviceAccount:priv-controlplane-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \  --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
```

samir: done. pods are coming up (2/6 up already). keeping the revert PR open pending proper role-mapping fix.

erin: thanks. Can we add an audit log alert for future regressions? Maybe a Datadog monitor on control-plane "kms:Decrypt AccessDenied" logs.

leo: also adding a unit test in infra that simulates role-prune to ensure kms perms roundtrip.

jordan: follow-up: we should avoid granting broad project roles in hotfix. Samir — can you instead make a namespaced binding rather than project-level? If gcloud doesn't support, create IAM condition restricting to the serviceAccount resource name + reason note.

samir: switched to the minimum scoped key role with condition on resource/serviceAccount. pushed PR #1427 with patch, adding terraform test.

qa: once PR merged, schedule canary to 10% for staging/dedicated tomorrow 04:00 UTC.

erin: retro note: runbook gap — role-prune checklist didn't include KMS permission smoke. I'll open a short doc.

jordan: assigning postmortem to erin + samir. Add timeline and root cause, and link to PRs.

erin: copied. closing thread once PR merged and canary is stable. :white_check_mark:
